additional_info.subject: Status Update - Charger Offline
additional_info.body:
Dear Francois,
Thank you for your message regarding this case.
I would like to inform you that the issue has been
resolved
.
Our customer has now installed the supply line meter, and the charger has been switched on again.
The original error
no longer occurs
and the charger is functioning normally. No onsite intervention or software update is required at this time.
I will proceed with
closing this case
.
Thank you for your support.
Best regards,
Laurenz Stelzl
